q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

**(a) Time left until resolution:**
The earnings release is expected August 26, 2026. Today is August 18, 2026. That's 8 days until resolution. This is an extremely near-term forecast with high certainty about timing.

**(b) Most likely outcome and why:**

The company has already issued forward guidance on May 20, 2026: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**, which establishes a range of $89.18B to $92.82B. This guidance was issued just 3 months ago and would typically be refined or adjusted by the time of the earnings announcement 8 days from now.

The research shows:
- NVIDIA's official midpoint guidance: $91.0B
- Analyst consensus: $91.85B (slightly above midpoint)
- Expected range: $89.18B - $92.82B based on the stated 2% tolerance

The most likely scenario is that NVIDIA either:
1. Maintains its May guidance at $91.0B ± 2%, or
2. Slightly adjusts it upward to approximately $91.5B-$92.5B given analyst consensus running slightly above midpoint

Given that analyst consensus is at $91.85B and this is based on actual business tracking data available to the Street, NVIDIA's guidance announcement will likely be in the $91B-$93B range.

**(c) What would push the value lower?**
- Unexpected weakness in data center demand between May and August 2026
- China-related headwinds stronger than anticipated in the May guidance
- General macro deterioration affecting enterprise capex
- Supply chain constraints limiting revenue realization
- Guidance miss from Q1 FY2027 results suggests conservative reset needed

**(d) What would push the value higher?**
- Better-than-expected demand for AI/data center chips
- Faster ramp of new products (mentioned Vera CPU platform)
- Higher pricing power than anticipated in May
- Enterprise acceleration beyond previous expectations
- Geographic diversification reducing China impact

**(e) Base rate or historical reference values:**

From the research provided:
- Q2 FY2026 revenue: $46.7 billion (mentioned for YoY comparison)
- Q2 FY2027 guidance (May 20, 2026): $91.0B ± 2%
- Q3 FY2027 analyst consensus: $103.1 billion (suggests continued strong trajectory)

The $91.0B guidance with ±2% range was issued just 3 months prior, making it the most reliable anchor. The analyst consensus of $91.85B suggests modest upward bias but within normal bounds.

**Reasoning for distribution:**
- The company has already telegraphed expectations at $91.0B midpoint
- Analyst consensus runs slightly above at $91.85B
- The ±2% margin suggests management confidence in the $89.18B-$92.82B band
- In a 3-month window (May to August), material changes to guidance are possible but unusual
- The trajectory to Q3 at $103.1B suggests Q2 guidance should support that path

I estimate the guidance will be approximately $91.5B with a reasonable range around this figure.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is expected to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings on August 26, 2026. For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA's guidance issued on May 20, 2026, projected revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, excluding any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). This guidance is significantly higher than Q2 FY2026 revenue of $46.7 billion, implying a 94% year-over-year increase [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors).

Analysts' consensus for Q2 FY2027 revenue is $91.85 billion, slightly above NVIDIA's midpoint guidance [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/), [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors). Looking ahead to Q3 FY2027, the consensus revenue forecast is $103.1 billion [rexshares.com](https://www.rexshares.com/nvidia-earnings/). NVIDIA's CFO Colette Kress anticipates $20 billion in total CPU revenue for the full fiscal year 2027, with the new Vera CPU opening up a new $200 billion market [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).
